description_detailed: To mark the 65th anniversary of Asterix and Obelix's first appearance in the magazine PILOTE in 1959, Monnaie de Paris is celebrating another anniversary of our two favorite Gauls by minting a new collection of coins and medals in their portrait. Since their first adventures, Asterix and Obelix have crossed far-flung lands and made friends all over the world! Their adventures have now been translated into 117 different languages, making our two Gauls veritable international icons of the comic strip world. Limited to 1 000 copies, this miniset features the three new 10, 20 and 50 centime denominations in Brilliant Uncirculated (BU) quality.This set contains all 8 French circulating denominations in Brilliant uncirculated (BU) quality. The €1 coin is minted exclusively for Miniset and proof quality series and will not be minted in circulating quality in 2024.
